title: Freecad operation reference
body:
# Freecad operation reference

Generated from the current declarations. Do not edit this file by hand.

All routes support shared document/value expressions and finite analytic studies through the framework runtime.
Lengths use millimetres. All outputs must be one valid positive-volume solid.
See [CAD and mesh workflows](../cad-and-mesh-workflows.md) for native and tessellated output limits.
Mould-release bodyDraft retains selected planar/cylindrical faces, neutral profile plane and optional pull axis; see [Draft feature workflows](../freecad-draft.md).
Native spreadsheet inputs and affine formula aliases drive editable part dimensions; see [engineering tables](../freecad-spreadsheets.md).
Checked importMesh makes a faceted Part solid from closed STL with explicit units, winding and frame; see [Mesh preparation](../freecad-mesh-preparation.md).
Editable straight-edged Draft profiles compose Part extrusions and booleans; see [polygon profiles](../freecad-draft-profiles.md).
